reason: The analyst's 'no effect' rests on one unjustified specification: the north-region subsample (N=633, about a third of the data), a 1% outcome trim, and only partial controls. The full-sample adjusted estimate is about 0.59 (SE 0.23, p≈0.01), and I got 0.58 with full controls. The north-only estimate is just an underpowered subgroup result, and its wide CI does not support concluding there is no effect.
